findings.detail: AC-3/TC-5's RED/GREEN discriminator is non-discriminating and AC-3's GREEN is unachievable. `curl .../input-group.json | grep -c ring-2` returns 1 pre-fix (className L35 'focused && border-ring ring-2 ring-ring/50') AND 1 post-fix (inside a // comment at L30). AC-3 demands 0 occurrences after redeploy, which a correct rebuild cannot satisfy; the comment lives in writeProhibited source. FIX: replace the bare-token count with a className-level assertion on the served files[].content - require ABSENCE of the exact class token ('border-ring ring-2 ring-ring/50', or any ring-2 in className position) and PRESENCE of focusedStyle + borderWidth: 2; keep the count only as a diagnostic. Apply to TC-5 and the RED expected value.

The registry-wide byte change + apex deploy invalidates a COMPLETED task's frozen evidence and pre-empts two Backlog tasks, and the charter says none of it. (a) ORI-DEP-001 (Completed) froze tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-DEP-001/asset-manifest.json (186 dist assets, 114 under r/, bound to release_sha 10d7f1de) and release.json.conversation_assets; scripts/docs-deploy/prepare.ts re-verify mode refuses ANY changed byte; ORI-DEP-001's VERIFY runs public-http.test.ts --phase bootstrap --check preparation asserting reverify.exit === 0 and hashOk. conversation.json/message.json/prompt-input.json each carry a self-dep, so 64 of 114 r/ assets change. WRITE-ALLOWED omits the ORI-DEP-001 evidence, public-http.test.ts, prepare.ts and scripts/docs-deploy/**. (b) ORI-DEP-002 must_observe requires receipt-listed URLs to match the prerequisite release + accepted manifest; ORI-DEP-003 writeProhibited bars registry/docs source fixes and its AC-4 requires 112 registry hashes to equal the accepted manifest with mismatches requiring a separately reviewed prerequisite update. This FIX IS that prerequisite update and does not say so. FIX: state explicitly that this FIX supersedes ORI-DEP-001's frozen manifest and receipt; add the ORI-DEP-001 evidence (and public-http.test.ts if needed) to WRITE-ALLOWED with a re-baseline produced by scripts/docs-deploy/prepare.ts --phase bootstrap (fresh) rather than a bare wrangler deploy; declare the sequencing handoff (the new asset-manifest.json becomes the accepted baseline for ORI-CI-004/ORI-DEP-002/ORI-DEP-003); the deploy must go through the deterministic prepare chain.

AC-2's `pnpm test` gate is unachievable as written. tests/sprint-05-orient-search/public-http.test.ts matches vitest's include glob, has zero describe/it, and fails with 'No test suite found in file' (verified directly and in a full run; CI runs the same command and last ran before the file landed). FIX: scope AC-2's vitest gate to the affected files (pnpm exec vitest run tests/build-registry.test.ts tests/sprint-02-shell-hero/resolve-deps.test.ts) and record the pre-existing public-http.test.ts no-suite failure with the AGENTS.md git stash && rerun proof, or add an explicit vitest exclusion for that script-style file.

AC-1 applies one engine-substituted regex to two shapes: registry.json self-deps keep the {engine} token and do not match ^https://rnraielements.com/r/(nativewind|uniwind)/.... FIX: assert the token form in registry.json and the substituted form in public/r/** as two separate checks.
AC-1/TC-1 write the template as .../v{version}/public/r/{engine}/{item}.json, but {item} is not a token in registry.json (the name is literal). FIX: write .../public/r/{engine}/<item-name>.json.

prebuild.ts L262 is a string argument to readJson (an error label), not a comment - correct the 'comment-only' label; and tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/verify-prompt-input-sdk57.ts:258 carries a stale {version} comment - add to the allowlist or list in OPEN QUESTIONS.

AC-3's VERIFY command has no build step, so running it on a stale dist deploys old bytes and reports success; it also bypasses scripts/docs-deploy/prepare.ts which the READING LIST calls the deterministic deploy-prep chain. FIX: put the ordered build (or prepare.ts) inside the AC-3 VERIFY command and reconcile the READING LIST.

Recorded: the commit bypassed the pre-commit gate via core.hooksPath=/dev/null. Acceptable for a single markdown spec (none of the righthook jobs read markdown; linked worktree has no node_modules). Condition: the implementation commit MUST run the real gates - no repeat bypass.

Wording overstatement: 'This is exactly RNR's own distribution shape: one canonical host (rnraielements.com) ... no registry index' - rnraielements.com is our host, and 'no registry index' conflicts with keeping our per-engine registry.json. FIX: reword.

summary: Diagnosis and measurements are sound and independently reproduced (64 self-deps/32 items/19 names; 146 RNR deps/48 items/14 names; live v0.2.1 pin; live ring-2 className; RNR same-host unversioned; full {version} blast radius). Three blocking defects: (1) AC-3's ring-2 grep oracle is a false oracle (1 before and 1 after) and its '0 occurrences' is unreachable; (2) the registry-wide byte change + deploy invalidates ORI-DEP-001's frozen manifest/receipt and pre-empts ORI-DEP-002/003 with no supersession or re-baseline declared and prepare.ts bypassed; (3) AC-2's pnpm test gate cannot pass because public-http.test.ts has no test suite (pre-existing).
